opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Designing the next generations of CPUs, GPUs and AI accelerators — up 31% YoY.

opex.name: Marketing, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling products and running the company.

opex.name: Amortization of acquisition intangibles
opex.note: Writing down the value of technology bought in acquisitions (Xilinx above all) — a bookkeeping charge, not cash.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago — a quarterly record

oneTimers: Discontinued operations added $71M below the line — profit from the server-rack manufacturing business (acquired with ZT Systems) that AMD agreed to sell; profit from continuing operations was $1,172M.
Stock-based compensation sits inside the expense lines; on AMD's non-GAAP view (which excludes it and acquisition amortization), net income was $1,965M instead of $1,243M.
otherDetail: Other income of $82M plus $10M of equity income, less $37M of interest expense, plus a $71M contribution from discontinued operations — a net +$126M.

segments.name: Data Center
segments.note: EPYC server processors and Instinct AI accelerators — up 22% as AI data centers kept buying; the segment earned $1,074M of operating profit.

segments.name: Client
segments.note: Ryzen processors for PCs — up 46% on strong demand and continued market-share gains.

segments.name: Gaming
segments.note: Graphics cards and console chips — up 181% YoY on Radeon GPU demand and recovering semi-custom console sales.

segments.name: Embedded
segments.note: Chips built into cars, industrial gear and communications equipment (the Xilinx business) — down 8% YoY.

takeaways.text: Client and Gaming together brought in $4.0B, up 73% YoY — Ryzen PC chips up 46% and Gaming up 181% — while Data Center grew 22% to $4.3B.
takeaways.title: Client and Gaming surged

takeaways.text: Gross margin reached 52%, up from 50% a year ago, as data-center products became a bigger share of the mix — and the quarter included no revenue from MI308 AI-chip shipments to China.
takeaways.title: Gross margin widened

takeaways.text: Free cash flow was a record $1,530M — 17% of revenue — as the quarter's profits converted straight into cash.
takeaways.title: Record free cash flow

verdict: AMD set a revenue record at $9.2B, up 36%, as Client and Gaming sales surged 73% and Data Center grew 22% — and profit rose 43% to $1.2B, helped by a $71M contribution from the business it is selling.
